policyDescription: Accepted FlightInput only; no state mutation after Start; observes fixed-tick state, not a human playtest. Easy manual fire is not emitted. See legal-pilot.ts and policyDigest for the exact input policy.
method: Initial createGame/startGame and accepted FlightInput only. No post-Start product state edits. Two concurrent Node workers; cpuMs is elapsed wall time, not process CPU use or a benchmark. A brief harness typecheck ran concurrently. This is an autonomous input driver, not a human first play. Easy fire-held is an inactive Space hold and equals idle; a separate turn-held comparison covers ArrowRight.
